description:
"We're getting a divorce." ...
Let's get a divorce." A simple sentence that instantly shattered the life of Jin Hyeonwoo, the heir to Seogang Group. His ideal life with his wife, Gaeul, and their son, which had seemed perfect, was shattered by just one unexpected statement. But why did this happen? Can Hyeonwoo discover the real reason behind the divorce proposal?
